title: A fix action's done_when names a version, and the registry moves under the plan
foundBy: deps-maintenance campaign, pilots 1 and 2: the pilot2 orchestrator's findings (campaign-workspaces/deps-maintenance/pilot2/archives/deps-pilot2-20260922T203209Z/orchestrator/output/findings.md) and the step corrections pilot3's coordination.md section 5 carries
details: A vulnerable change's `done_when` reads `no advisory affects the pinned version: 3.1.6 or newer`. The number is stale by the time anyone runs the step. In pilot2, 8 of 10 rows of one `npm audit fix` landed above the version the report named, and fast-uri landed at 3.1.8 rather than 3.1.6, both correctly. A version is also the wrong test: a newer release can carry an advisory of its own. The condition that matters is that the lockfile no longer carries a copy the advisory affects. `npm audit fix` exits 0 whether or not it changed anything, so its exit code proves nothing either, and the file does not say so.
